description: Screenshot of two tweets about the December 2017 Alabama Senate special election. Donald J. Trump (@realDonaldTrump) congratulates Doug Jones on his victory, crediting write-in votes and predicting Republicans will contest the seat again soon. Below it, an account styled as Julian Assange (@Real_Assange_) questions how many 'dead people and illegal aliens' voted for Jones; the underscore-suffixed handle indicates a parody/impersonation account, not Assange's real account.
text: Donald J. Trump @realDonaldTrump · 28m. Congratulations to Doug Jones on a hard fought victory. The write-in votes played a very big factor, but a win is a win. The people of Alabama are great, and the Republicans will have another shot at this seat in a very short period of time. It never ends! 34K 8.5K 30K. Julian Assange @Real_Assange_ · 26m. I wonder how many dead people and illegal aliens voted for #DougJones? 126 49 143
flags: @Real_Assange_ is not Julian Assange's genuine account; its voter-fraud insinuation is an unverified claim

description: Frame from a Fox News broadcast showing an on-screen graphic titled 'Inspector General Report'. The graphic quotes notes from page 294 of the DOJ Inspector General report concerning Anthony Weiner ('Wiener [sic]') texting a 15-year-old and the initial analysis of his laptop, with the phrase 'Hillary Clinton & Foundation Crime Against Children' circled in red by whoever captured the image. A news ticker about the Kashmir conflict runs along the bottom and a round stamp watermark reading 'KAG BOT OFFICIAL' sits at lower right.
text: INSPECTOR GENERAL REPORT. (3) Wiener [sic] - texting 15 yo - Sexually Explicit. Initial analysis of laptop - thousands emails. Hillary Clinton & Foundation Crime Against Children. PAGE 294. FOX NEWS 10:08 ET. MIR," AND SUPPORTED PEACEFUL RESOLUTION OF KASHMIR CONFLICT... DISPUTE DATES TO 1947 PART. KAG BOT OFFICIAL
orgs: Department of Justice Office of Inspector General
flags: The circled phrase is a quoted case-note heading from the IG report, not a finding that Clinton or the Foundation committed crimes against children; the red circle is an added annotation steering that inference

description: Screenshot of Q drop #2872 (8chan post No.5328186, Feb 22 2019), which quotes an Anonymous post embedding an excerpt from the DOJ Inspector General report. The excerpt reproduces FBI official Randy Coleman's October 4 journal notes about the Anthony Weiner laptop, with the word 'Children' highlighted in the line 'Hillary Clinton & Foundation Crime Against Children', followed by the report's caveat that Coleman said the notes likely reflected a morning briefing. The anon links a justice.gov download and Q replies by restating the highlighted phrase.
text: Q !!mG7VJxZNCI ID: f55f0b No.5328186 2872. Feb 22 2019 13:34:11 (EST) NEW. Anonymous ID: 3f8dfc No.5328018. Feb 22 2019 13:28:24 (EST) NEW. 683CC25B-98FA-46B8-AEFE-B3A0285DADF5.jpeg. Coleman told us that he kept regularly took notes in a journal. Coleman's notes from October 4 contained the following entry:. (1) Anthony Wiener [sic]. (2) [Unrelated]. (3) Wiener [sic] - texting 15 yo - Sexually Explicit. 9/26 - Federal SW - IPhone/IPAD/Laptop. Initial analysis of laptop - thousands emails. Hillary Clinton & Foundation. Crime Against Children. We asked Coleman about these notes and he told us that, given their placement in his notebook, the notes would most likely represent information he was briefed on first thing in the morning by his subordinates in the Criminal Investigative Division. Coleman stated that he may have passed this information to other FBI executives after the morning briefing with the Director, but he could not remember if that occurred here. >>5327931. And children*. >https://www.justice.gov/file/1071991/download. >>5328018. Hillary Clinton & Foundation. Crime Against Children. Q
orgs: Department of Justice Office of Inspector General
flags: The quoted note is Coleman's briefing journal entry as reproduced in the IG report, not a finding of crimes; Q's restatement presents the phrase as an implied accusation

description: The Punisher skull logo: a stylized elongated white skull with narrowed angular eye sockets and long vertical teeth, on a solid black background. The emblem originates with the Marvel Comics vigilante character the Punisher and was widely used in Q-adjacent posts as a signal of coming 'punishment' of alleged wrongdoers.

Photograph taken from inside a car (dashboard and windshield edge visible in the foreground) showing a large black square banner mounted on a gray-painted brick wall beside a driveway. The banner bears a big letter Q filled with an American flag stars-and-stripes pattern and an eagle-head motif, with the QAnon slogan 'WHERE WE GO ONE, WE GO ALL!' arced above it. Trees, a streetlight, and what appears to be a beverage cooler or vending unit with Monster and Zyn branding stand at left; the location is not identified. The filename's epoch timestamp corresponds to July 2019.
text: WHERE WE GO ONE, WE GO ALL!
flags: Location of the building/banner is not identified
